claims.claim: Enabling applicationcontroller.enable.impersonation per-project forces diff operations to run as the destination service account, which lacks patch verbs on cluster-scoped resources, causing ComparisonError failures that the control plane credential would not trigger.
The hydrator's commit server currently pushes unsigned commits, which will cause Argo CD to reject its own output if the hydrated branch enforces SourceIntegrity policy with GPG verification.

The roadmap explicitly states ordered deletion of ApplicationSet children is out of scope and teardown remains manual, while the PRD and pilot notes mandate deletionOrder: Reverse and block progressive sync in hydrator pilots until a debounce is implemented.

The PRD explicitly excludes custom deletion strategy as a non-goal, yet the backlog ticket T-28755 proposes a parallelGroups API extension that functionally requires custom step ordering to achieve parallel progressive sync.

The progressive sync status logic promotes child applications to Healthy based on pre-update state before the generated spec is applied, creating a blind spot that the requested T-27846 metrics do not yet cover.

The auto-sync skip behavior in T-27875 is caused by the controller comparing Status.Sync.Revision against HEAD instead of OperationState.SyncResult.Revision, which masks the actual sync state during concurrent commits.

proposals.change: Record that the root cause is impersonation routing diff runs to the destination service account, which lacks patch on cluster-scoped resources, to stop the reporter from chasing the cluster secret.
proposals.citedLine: the CI diff failures (the missing-permissions one, T-26271) got root-caused on the call: with impersonation on, diff runs as the destination service account which doesn't hold patch on cluster-scoped stuff.

proposals.change: Update the ticket status to reflect deprioritization to next quarter and note that the dev pair is moving to the progressive sync deletion loop instead.
proposals.citedLine: hydrator rollback work (the history & rollback ticket, T-27327) is deprioritized to next quarter. dev pair moves to the progressive sync deletion loop instead. ticket should say so.

proposals.change: Add the standing restriction that hydrator pilot repos must not use progressive sync until a debounce is implemented.
proposals.citedLine: hydrator pilot repos must not use progressive sync until there's a debounce.

deltas.body: Impersonation rollout is gated behind a per-project flag rather than a fleet-wide toggle, and no project may enable it until the diff story is resolved.
deltas.citedLine: impersonation rollout: we decided it goes behind a per-project flag, not fleet-wide. nobody flips it on a project until the diff story is fixed.

deltas.body: The operational rule for the delete/recreate loop is to switch the ApplicationSet to AllAtOnce deletion before manually deleting any child app until the controller fix lands.
deltas.citedLine: mitigation for now: incident runbook says switch the ApplicationSet to AllAtOnce deletion before deleting any child app by hand.

deltas.citedLine: also priya flagged that our stage-branch promoter is still the shell script, nobody owns it. parking that.
